rows.note: Use this as the everyday choice when someone drinks coffee to wake up or feel more alert.

example.english: I need to caffeinate by drinking coffee in the morning so I can get through the meeting.
example.traditional: 我朝早要飲咖啡提神，先至捱得過個會議。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 jiu3 jam2 gaa3 fe1 tai4 san4 sin1 zi3 ngaai4 dak1 gwo3 go3 wui6 ji5

rows.note: Use this for the general act of consuming caffeine, including caffeine from tea, energy drinks, or other sources rather than specifically coffee.

example.english: People who caffeinate through tea should still watch their daily intake.
example.traditional: 即使透過飲茶攝取咖啡因，都應該留意每日嘅份量。
example.jyutping: zik1 si2 tau3 gwo3 jam2 caa4 sip3 ceoi2 gaa3 fe1 jan1 dou1 jing1 goi1 lau4 ji3 mui5 jat6 ge3 fan6 loeng6

rows.jyutping: gaa1 gaa3 fe1 jan1 lok6 A
rows.note: Use this when caffeine is deliberately added to a drink, food, or other substance.

example.english: They caffeinate this soft drink by adding caffeine to it, so people feel more alert after drinking it.
example.traditional: 工場會加咖啡因落汽水，令飲完嘅人醒神啲。
example.jyutping: gung1 coeng4 wui5 gaa1 gaa3 fe1 jan1 lok6 hei3 seoi2 ling6 jam2 jyun4 ge3 jan2 sing2 san4 di1
